purpose: Convert current NFL personnel availability into auditable point-spread-equivalent Graham matchup adjustments using the source-locked Walters Chapters 21-22 framework.

sourceAuthority.primary: Billy Walters with Armen Keteyian, Gambler, Chapters 21-22, especially pp. 237-238 and 245-263
principles: Every relevant variable must be expressed in point-spread-equivalent units.
Key players receive numerical values; published rankings may be used only after conversion to point-spread-relevant values.
If a player is out, remove his value and add the replacement player's value.
If a player plays hurt, reduce his value according to a specifically supported effectiveness percentage.
Cluster injuries may be nonlinear and require unit-specific treatment.
Quarterbacks use a separate valuation scale.
Current personnel adjustments are game-specific overlays unless an explicit carried-rating transaction separately changes the base team rating.

marketIsolation.rule: Never reverse-engineer a player or replacement value from a sportsbook move.

rankingLayer.provider: EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 official ratings database
rankingLayer.waltersCompatibility: Chapter 22 explicitly permits Madden or ESPN player rankings as a starting ranking system but requires conversion into point-spread values.
rankingLayer.snapshotPolicy: Lock the first verified 2026 OVR captured for a player under this calibration. Do not automatically follow later Madden rating changes; a later value change requires an explicit PLAYER_VALUE_RECALIBRATION event to avoid double counting weekly performance.

QUESTIONABLE.note: Do not turn the designation alone into a point estimate.

DOUBTFUL.note: Do not turn the designation alone into a point estimate.

replacementRule.replacementSelection: Use the current verified depth-chart/role replacement expected to absorb the missing player's primary role; cite the roster/depth source. Never choose a replacement based on market reaction.

RECEIVER.automaticWhen: two highest-valued currently expected receiving options are simultaneously unavailable
RECEIVER.sourceBasis: Walters example: top two receivers valued 2.5 and 1.5 may be worth 50 percent more together than their additive loss.

DEFENSIVE_LINE.automaticWhen: two or more positive-value defensive-line players are simultaneously unavailable and their replacements are verified
DEFENSIVE_LINE.sourceBasis: Walters gives a defensive-lineman cluster example of adding roughly 40 percent.

matchupOverride.rule: A base player value may be overridden for a specific matchup only when matchup mechanics make the player's absence materially different from normal, with explicit football reasoning and sourceRefs. The override must never use a market move as evidence.
matchupOverride.sourceExample: Walters describes Tristan Wirfs as normally around 1.3 points but potentially worth as many as 6 in a specific Rams matchup because of the pass-rush, backup injury and cascading protection effects.

gameApplication.teamDeltaDefinition: replacement/effective contribution minus healthy contribution; a negative number weakens that team
gameApplication.fairFormula: newGrahamFairHome = priorIndependentFairHome + sum(new governed game-specific adjustment deltas)
gameApplication.rounding: Preserve calculations to 0.05 internally; publish Graham fair to the board's existing half-point convention unless the current board explicitly supports finer precision.
gameApplication.carriedRatingRule: Do not write a temporary injury/personnel overlay into currentRating. A permanent carried-rating move requires its own separately audited transaction.

doubleCountGuard.pregame: Personnel overlay is applied once to the matchup fair.
doubleCountGuard.postgame: TGPL injury differential accounts for the injury environment when learning from the result. Do not then carry the same pregame injury overlay forward a second time.
doubleCountGuard.ratingInputChange: A later player-value recalibration is not retroactively applied to completed TGPL calculations unless an explicit correction transaction is approved.
